description: Full-population flag/kind adjudication + preregistered recall sample for semantic_vacuous_pending_review (issue 189). Protocol preregistered and frozen before the first paid call. Per-row verdicts: vacuity-adjudication-2026-08-09.jsonl (join key: source_sha256 + clause_context_sha256, never clause_index).

panel.context: full source SKILL.md supplied per (skill, seat) call; seats blind to detector flag/kind/reason and prior verdicts

arm_A_census.note: Census, not a sample: 0.9574-0.9610 is the population figure for this instrument triple; remaining uncertainty is adjudicator uncertainty only.

arm_B_recall.design: n=120 stratified by oracle tier from the 1,015 unflagged clauses (t1=370/44, t2=599/61, t3=46/15), drawn without replacement, seed 189
arm_B_recall.note: Never quote the recall point without an interval; skill-level n is 47. Bootstrap resamples the 47 skills with replacement (2000 reps, seed 189).

arm_C_kind.note: Overall 0.9667 is published only beside the class split (255/255 and 6/15). weak_directive predictions remain ADVISORY (precision 0.40). Historical S211 class split of record is 77/77 + 4/20 = 81/97; the published 77/78 was an off-by-one denominator, reconciled 2026-08-09.

agreement.note: Per-arm figures are the quotable ones; the pooled 0.866 is inflated by pooling two populations with opposite base rates.

leakage_rule: Every row adjudicated by this program is development/diagnosis material only for any future detector revision. A prompt or schema change stamps a NEW extractor generation; evaluation of a revision runs on held-out skills and clauses against per-class thresholds preregistered before the holdout runs.
generation_lock: All figures die with the instrument triple above. A row from any other triple has NO calibration claim.
supersedes_note: Extends (does not replace) receipt vacuity-flag-calibration-2026-08-08: that receipt remains the loaded calibration default pending a coordinated README/label update; this receipt is the committed record of the issue-189 program and the source of the per-row ADJUDICATED upgrades.
